name: Dancer Pose
description: Standing balance holding the back foot and kicking it up while the chest reaches forward.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand tall in Mountain Pose and shift your weight onto one foot.
Bend the other knee and hold the inside of that foot or ankle behind you.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your feet together and arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Dancer Pose
keyframes.cue: Hold the right foot, kick it up and back, and reach the left arm forward.

cues: Kick the foot into the hand.
